Dear The Synergist Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position. With 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing and project coordination, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of tackling global societal challenges through effective communication.

In my current role at Episto, I manage multi-channel campaigns, coordinate content production, and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring projects stay on track and deadlines are met. My technical background in SEO and web design, combined with my organizational skills, makes me well-suited to support your team as an operational engine.

I am proficient in tools like Asana, Google Workspace, WordPress, Canva, and Figma, and I am quick to adopt new technologies. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, open to hybrid work.

I am drawn to The Synergist's mission and would be thrilled to bring my energy and operational skills to your purpose-driven organization. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position at The Synergist. Your mission to address complex global issues like health equity and rare diseases through collaboration deeply resonates with me. I am eager to contribute my organizational skills and digital marketing expertise to support your team's impactful work.

With over two years of experience in digital marketing and project coordination, I have developed a strong ability to manage multi-channel campaigns and keep projects moving efficiently. At Episto, I currently handle on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site maintenance for multiple clients. This role has honed my skills in coordinating with vendors, managing timelines, and ensuring deliverables are met—skills that directly align with your need for a proactive 'chaser'.

I am proficient in tools like Asana, Google Workspace, WordPress, Canva, and Figma, and I am comfortable learning new platforms quickly. My technical background in web design and SEO allows me to understand the intricacies of digital assets and brand libraries, ensuring consistency across all channels. I have also managed social media integration for projects like mirook.com, where I built a complete website and implemented structured data to enhance visibility.

I am a natural organizer who thrives in fast-paced environments. My experience in logistics at Katoen Natie taught me the importance of accuracy and efficiency, which I carry into every project. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, ready to embrace your hybrid work structure.

I am inspired by The Synergist's dedication to creating collective impact. I am confident that my operational skills, proactive mindset, and passion for meaningful work would make me a valuable addition to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your initiatives.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
